summary: OSpec 1.9.2 keeps an approved Goal planning review valid across implementation progress and makes the single grouped planning repair converge instead of dead-ending the Goal.
improved: The post-repair planning re-review is now a delta review: it receives the round-one findings, baseline-to-current diffs of the repaired files, and explicit finality guidance instead of re-auditing the whole planning set blind.

A completed grouped planning repair whose findings were all medium severity or lower settles deterministically as APPROVED_WITH_CONCERNS with no AI re-review; task reviews and the final review remain the semantic safety net.
The final review dispatched after a deterministic verification failure is scoped to diagnosing that failure instead of re-auditing areas the previous final review already approved.

ospec-change raises Brainstorm-First decision gates only for genuine forks such as mutually exclusive API, UI, data-model, or destructive-operation choices; routine unambiguous changes proceed with recorded assumptions in proposal.md.
fixed: Approved combined planning reviews now bind to planning semantics, so task status updates, checklist ticks, review bookkeeping, generated repair tasks, and implementation commits no longer invalidate them mid-goal or re-dispatch full planning reviews.
A planning repair executor failure that changed no planning content re-arms the single grouped repair allowance instead of permanently blocking the Goal on an infrastructure error.
Planning review invalidation feedback no longer describes a planning review as a final review.
docs: Synchronized the planning repair, delta re-review, and deterministic acceptance rules across README, usage, loop engineering, for-ai protocols, project conventions, and generated project templates in all four languages.
